handbookNote: North Carolina Real Estate license exam. RECONSTRUCTED CONFIG: this track's original build session did not leave a local track-config/questionsDir on this machine -- the 152 live questions existed only in D1 (row IDs likely prefixed similarly to other self-gen tracks). For this pool-depth backfill pass (2026-08-31), the 152 live questions were exported directly from D1 and split by their existing 'topic' column into 6 bucket files under nc_re_salesperson_questions/ (Agency Agreements/Disclosure & Dual/Designated Agency 24, Broker Conduct/Broker-in-Charge & Compensation 30, Handling Trust Funds & BPO/CMA 37, Licensure & the Real Estate Commission 22, Prohibited Acts & Agency Law 26, Residential Disclosures & Closing 13) to serve as inventory/style reference for backfill agents. IMPORTANT EXAM-STRUCTURE NOTE (confirmed via research 2026-08-31): North Carolina does NOT have a separate 'broker' license exam -- all NC licensees are called 'brokers' from the start; a new licensee is a 'provisional broker' who completes a 75-hour pre-licensing course and passes the state exam (140 scored items: 80 national + 60 state-specific, ~10 unscored pretest items, 75% pass on each section separately -- i.e. 60/80 national and 45/60 state), then becomes a full 'broker' after 90 hours of postlicensing education within 18 months -- NOT a second proctored exam. This track_registry entry (exam_question_count=60, min_correct=45) tracks the STATE-SPECIFIC portion of the exam only, consistent with this project's convention of focusing state tracks on state-specific content where a national+state split exists. Price set at $29.99 (2999 cents) to match this project's standardized Real Estate track rate. Backfill new-question IDs use prefix 'nc_re_salesperson-deepen1-*', which will not collide with the original IDs already in D1.
